shared_elements: low-relief carving on a broad rectangular pillar face
upright pillar with a projecting head/capital
justification: Both show shallow relief on a broad pillar face with a herringbone/chevron-like linear motif rendered in the same flat, low-relief schematic manner, and both pillars carry an upper projecting element. However, B is densely populated with specific figurative imagery — quadrupeds in profile, a bird with long neck, a snake, rows of arched/loop signs and a fringed band — while A is purely abstract, showing only chevron columns and rectilinear panels with no creatures at all.
